topic: Salivary Gland and Rare Head and Neck Tumours
rejected: ASCO salivary-gland guideline, which is not open full text

source.title: Salivary gland cancer: ESMO–European Reference Network on Rare Adult Solid Cancers (EURACAN) Clinical Practice Guideline for diagnosis, treatment and follow-up
source.whyItFits: The 2022 ESMO–EURACAN guideline is open on PMC and covers diagnosis, staging, surgery, and radiotherapy for salivary-gland carcinoma. The ASCO guideline is not open.
